messages.recipient_title: Global Head of Government Relations & Chief Sustainability Officer
messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | Rolls-Royce | Government Relations & Sustainability
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Mamic,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for Rolls-Royce, focused on government relations, sustainability governance, industrial transformation and lower-carbon technology deployment. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief sets out areas where my background could support institutional alignment and implementation. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic mandates where this experience would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Rolls-Royce
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Global Head of Government Relations & Chief Sustainability Officer
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers a leadership profile aligned with Rolls-Royce's agenda across government relations, sustainability governance, industrial transformation, resilient supply chains and lower-carbon technology deployment. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security, aviation and technical teams, translating external obligations into coordinated execution. For Rolls-Royce, his strongest contribution would sit where government engagement, sustainability commitments and operational delivery need common governance, evidence and executive accountability across markets and business units.
strategic_brief.company_context: Rolls-Royce is advancing transformation across Civil Aerospace, Defence and Power Systems while continuing investment in growth, resilience and lower-carbon solutions. Public 2026 disclosures show strong operating momentum alongside practical emissions-reduction measures and strategic investments. Government relations and sustainability therefore operate close to core commercial and industrial decisions, including market access, localization, technology policy, supply-chain resilience and customer decarbonization. A joined-up approach can help ensure external commitments are realistic, operationally owned and supported by traceable evidence. This creates a strong case for leadership that connects ministries, regulators, partners and communities with internal business, technical and support functions.

opportunities.title: Government sustainability integration
opportunities.rationale: Government engagement and sustainability increasingly converge around industrial policy, energy security, localization and emissions performance. Integrating these agendas can strengthen credibility and reduce fragmented external commitments across markets.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can connect stakeholder mapping, policy engagement and sustainability governance through shared issue registers, decision logs, accountable owners and executive reporting routines.

opportunities.title: Operational evidence assurance
opportunities.rationale: Sustainability claims are strongest when performance data, project evidence and management ownership are aligned across operations, procurement, technical functions and external partners before public communication.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can build assurance-ready evidence registers and accountability matrices that link external commitments to source data, responsible teams, review gates and management decisions.

opportunities.title: Localization partnership governance
opportunities.rationale: Strategic markets increasingly expect industrial participation, workforce development, local supply-chain value and long-term partnership outcomes alongside commercial investment and technology deployment.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can coordinate government-facing localization programmes with procurement, HR, operations and partnership teams, producing measurable commitments and consistent evidence for institutional engagement.

days_0_30: Map priority government, sustainability, localization and regulatory interfaces.
days_31_60: Create integrated issue, commitment and evidence registers with clear owners.
days_61_90: Launch cross-functional governance for priority markets and sustainability workstreams.
days_91_180: Embed assurance checks, metrics and executive reporting across selected programmes.

potential_impact: Stronger alignment between government relations and sustainability commitments.
More defensible evidence behind external claims.
Clearer localization ownership across business functions.
background_relevance: Government and regulatory relations across multiple public authorities.
ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and social-performance leadership.
Cross-functional coordination with operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security and technical teams.
